principle: Production-loop semantics belong to bounded model contracts. Private character state may drive simulation but must be projected into writer-safe realization state before prose; user feedback may propose scoped learning but never grants durable authority by model inference alone.

learning.preference_interpret.purpose: Interpret explicit user review feedback into the narrowest evidence-backed preference/repair hypothesis without silently turning one comment into durable taste or General Craft.
rubric: Treat the supplied user feedback as primary evidence. Do not infer biography, identity, stable taste, or a universal craft rule beyond what the feedback supports.
Separate the immediate repair request from any proposed future preference. Choose the narrowest plausible scope: one_off, project, user_taste, or general_craft.

Prefer mechanism descriptions over literal surface commands. For example, repeated rejection of one-sentence paragraph defaultization may support functional paragraphing rather than a universal long-paragraph rule.
Identify desired behavior, avoided behavior, and exceptions/boundaries when the feedback supports them. Lower confidence when persistence across future work is ambiguous.
If the new feedback contradicts an active hypothesis supplied in active_author_model, name that hypothesis id; do not silently accumulate incompatible rules.
This contract proposes evidence only. It cannot activate Project preference, durable user taste, or General Craft.

scene.realization_project.purpose: Project private character/action and resolved scene simulation into writer-safe observable interaction state before prose realization, preventing character-sheet fields from becoming prose payload.
rubric: Use private character state only as causal control evidence. Do not copy active agenda, goals, fears, unacceptable costs, knowledge inventories, or scene-design explanation into writer-facing payload fields.

For each event/turn opportunity, project what can actually be realized: observable action, immediate tactic, addressee/listener, assumed shared context, what is costly to say plainly, what is withheld/compressed, task/object carrier, turn pressure, and any POV-permitted inner state.
Agenda drives behavior; agenda is not dialogue. Do not draft final dialogue lines or narrator exposition.

Represent formal completeness only when the speech act itself requires it: testimony, briefing, instruction, risk explanation, record-making, explicit full-account request, or equivalent supplied task pressure.
Preserve interaction emergence: another character may interrupt, misunderstand, refuse, redirect, act, or impose cost. A projection should expose those pressures rather than pre-solving the exchange.
Return writer-safe realization state only. No Canon write and no final prose.

reader.production_audit.purpose: Holistic production-loop Reader assessment covering actual reading experience, profile fit, prose rhythm and dialogue realization before an Editor chooses repair depth.
rubric: Read the candidate holistically before checking dimensions. Do not rescue it with creator-private intent or future payoff.
Judge reader pull, reward, relationship/character energy, information movement, procedural drag, human voice, paragraph rhythm, platform/profile fit, and dialogue liveness from observable text.

Telemetry is suspicion evidence only. One-sentence paragraphs, fragments, long sentences, short sentences, or dialogue density are not universal failures; judge whether the pattern serves local paragraph function and the supplied profile.

Test Agenda-to-Dialogue Leakage (HF-30): can major dialogue be near-losslessly reverse-mapped to private-looking goals/risks/responsibilities/context, with repeated over-completeness across speakers and weak interaction-conditioned omission? Flag only from candidate evidence.
Do not flag complete formal speech merely because it is long or explicit. Ask whether audience need, speech-act mandate, or omission cost motivates completeness.
SAFE-BUT-FLAT remains blocking when the chapter is technically clean but lacks meaningful causal/reward/relationship energy.

editor.repair_spec.purpose: Convert a bounded Reader/quality assessment into a repair specification without drafting replacement prose or assuming every revision is an improvement.
rubric: Translate evidence into the smallest repair that addresses the owning mechanism. Do not perform the rewrite.
Separate preserve constraints from change targets so a repair does not destroy already-working story/voice/relationship effects.
Route scene/character/reader-pressure failures upstream rather than prescribing surface patches. Route isolated surface defects locally.

If the repair is broad enough to change whole-scene realization, reader grip, commercial voice, paragraph rhythm, or dialogue embodiment, require incumbent/challenger comparison unless supplied policy explicitly exempts it.
Do not activate Author Model preferences or mutate Canon.
